Integration seat, 09:20 MST (rotated at 08:47, same handle).

1. origin/integration = a7c4e3059c7: main f5128d18cf1 synced in (fast gate 48 passed).
2. #4043 (base integration): BUG-2555 test fix, test-only. Cause of the promotion 9 red: main's #4012 umask hook resets the umask to 022 before main in every test binary, so the test's child lost the 002 set by pre_exec. The child now sets it itself. dell1: 74 passed. I am merging it under review-after-merge once the fast gate on the merge result passes; it still needs a review record.
3. #4044 (base integration): BUG-2580. queue work publishes a clean seat's committed, unpushed work by the ship --from-seat route, then the lane-end fast gate runs. dell1: check clean, 134 passed. Not exercised on a live lane. Needs review before I merge it (it changes lane publication).
4. Warning for after 9b (#4040) lands: 9b reverts the #4003 merge. When main is synced back into integration, that revert removes BUG-2555 (code and test) from integration. I will re-apply it (revert of the revert) right after that sync, as its own PR; tell me if you want it handled differently.
5. Nothing else is approved: #4022 waits for re-review at a88e3f89cdf (verdict still CR at a2e83048e987), #4038 has no verdict, #3950 and #3986 are CR.
6. Next here: STORY-2768 S3a timing (rebuild in progress), then BUG-2583, BUG-2579.
subject: integration a7c4e3059c7; #4043 BUG-2555 test fix, #4044 BUG-2580 need review
